title: Two hundred retained, fifty replayed
summary: A log console that replays what it missed and then runs live, with a ring nobody wrote and an undo stack over the filter's own past values.

bench.note: AUTHORED, not measured — nothing here runs until the compiler does. LINES OF CODE IS THE EXCEPTION: counted from the two arms in this download, code lines only, both arms complete — markup, client and handler. The hand-written arm is a ring too, which is the point: the rows below are what writing one costs, not what avoiding one saves.

rows.metric: DOM nodes moved per arriving line

tests.note: `bun test examples/tail`. The gap-and-duplicate case is asserted on the SEQUENCE a reader received, not on the rendered list: a replay that overlapped the live cursor by one paints a list that looks right until two lines happen to match.

rows.name: a reader replays `min(n, retained)` and goes live with no gap
raising `tail` from 50 to 5000 does not make a write dearer
a value mutated in place retains one reference and replays nothing
an entry past its `ttl` is dropped on the read that follows
